name: Experion The Trillion
summary: The project, developer (Experion Developers Pvt Ltd), Sector 48 Sohna Road location, HARERA number GGM/911/643/2025/14, 5.5 acres, 3 towers and 540 units are all confirmed. Our July 2029 possession is close to the marketed August 2029, but the RERA completion date is 31 Dec 2032. Our unit sizes do not match any source: we list 3 BHK 2,013 and 4 BHK 1,905 sq ft, while sources give 3 BHK 2,842–3,000 and 4 BHK 3,529–3,601 sq ft. Our 4 BHK is also smaller than our 3 BHK. Our ₹5.83 Cr starting price is at the low end, since sources range from ₹5.96 Cr to ₹8.22 Cr.
